border_radius.description: Focus-border corner radius (px) — approximate macOS window rounding.

width.description: Border stroke width in points; display-edge allowance and one shared gap between tiles. Zero disables borders and spacing.

colors.stacked.description: Focused tile is part of a stack (cyan).

colors.moved.description: Movement mode: the window being moved (royal blue).

colors.move_to.description: Movement mode: the virtual move-to cursor (pink).

colors.drop_edge.description: Movement mode: the staged drop edge (vivid amber).
